The sell multliplier was a feature in DonutSMP that boosted the /sell value of an item for a player up to 3x of what it originally is, making it considered an infinite money source by many.




The multipliers require selling certain amounts worth in money of the specific category to unlock the next one and simply give more money in /sell. The requirements go as follows (the values on the right are how much money you need to get from selling the specific category of item):

The sell multiplier could be used to somewhat manipulate the market. For example if you had a 2.7x multiplier for sweet berries, you could order sweet berries for $26 while also making profit for the money you put in.
